name: the save helper is running (python3 -I scripts/ds_save.py)
assert: async () => { try { return (await (await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:7879/health')).json()).ok; } catch { return false; } }

eval: () => { document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: '\\', bubbles: true })); return true; }

() => { const el = document.querySelector('.ds-panel input[data-colour="--chart"]'); el.value = '#e8590c'; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return DS.token('--chart'); }

() => { const el = document.querySelector('.ds-panel input[data-t="--r-lg"]'); for (const v of [4]) { el.value = v; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); } el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return DS.token('--r-lg'); }
() => { const i = document.querySelector('[data-preset-name]'); i.value = 'Gate test'; document.querySelector('[data-preset-save]').click(); return true; }

name: Save writes ds/presets.js through the helper (not a session preset)
assert: async () => { const j = await (await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:7879/presets')).json(); const p = j.presets.find((x) => x.slug === 'gate-test'); return !!p && p.overrides['--chart'] === '#e8590c' && p.overrides['--r-lg'] === '4px' && p.theme === 'mouka' && /Saved “Gate test”/.test(document.querySelector('.dsp-msg').textContent); }

eval: () => { const el = document.querySelector('.ds-panel input[data-t="--r-lg"]'); for (const v of [8]) { el.value = v; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); } el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return DS.token('--r-lg'); }

waitFor: async () => { const j = await (await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:7879/presets')).json(); return j.presets.find((x) => x.slug === 'gate-test')?.overrides['--r-lg'] === '8px'; }
